Connecting with other students before they arrive helps bridge the gap between receiving an offer and starting their studies, giving students the opportunity to build friendships, ask questions and feel part of their new community. We help our university partners strengthen peer-to-peer engagement, improve conversion, enhance the student experience and support retention by ensuring students feel connected and supported from the outset. Our platform, combined with the services around it, helps universities create more connected student communities and deliver a meaningful impact across higher education. We’re proud to work with more than 155 universities across 23 countries, including some of the world’s leading higher education institutions. Our global network continues to grow, and we’re excited to keep making a meaningful impact on the student experience around the world. We’d love for you to be part of that journey! The job As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll play an important role in launching and managing the Goin' products at our university partners, building strong client relationships and supporting successful renewals. You’ll work closely with university teams to understand their goals, help them get the most from Goin’, and use data, insights and recommendations to demonstrate the value of their community. Ultimately, your work will help our partners succeed and students feel more connected, confident and ready to take their next step. Client meetings – Organise and lead productive, engaging meetings that build momentum, share progress and turn conversations into clear next steps. Building strong relationships – Build trust through friendly, proactive and transparent communication. Monitoring client health – Use customer success tools, digital platforms and regular partner conversations to understand engagement, satisfaction and where additional support may be needed.
